Maya (CS): Heads-up: a small cohort of evaluation accounts are seeing intermittent missing embeddings and delayed search results after the weekend content import. A couple are high-touch pilots with renewal discussions coming up. We should coordinate comms, a mitigation timeline, and a short-term compensation policy.

Maya (CS): Proposed quick customer note for transparency (will tailor per account):

"Hi <Name>,

We identified an intermittent issue affecting content indexing for some evaluation accounts following a bulk import. Our engineers have deployed a mitigation; you may see improved search and embeddings in the next few hours. We're offering prioritized troubleshooting and a one-time credit while we validate recovery.

Immediate actions we are taking:
- Hourly status updates until we hit stable metrics
- Two dedicated troubleshooting office hours (RSVP link)
- One-time credit applied if SLAs missed

We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience.

— Maya, Customer Success"

Liam (Eng): Root cause: import job spiked shard I/O and triggered a backpressure branch in the embeddings pipeline; some worker leases expired and tasks were retried out-of-order leading to missed writes. Short-term mitigation: raised worker lease timeout and retried failed writes. Patch deployed to canaries, expanding now. Will post canary metrics (embeddings.write_failures, search.missing_count).

Sofia (Support): Setting up a dedicated support channel and a triage doc for customers to paste diagnostics (last ingest ID, job status, small curl checks). Scheduling office hours for tomorrow 09:00 PT and 15:00 PT. I'll include an optional walkthrough slot for any account that prefers a 1:1.

Carlos (Sales): Please tag accounts within 90 days of renewal and ARR > $75k. I'll hold renewal nudges and prep an exec note template if any account requests escalation. Also happy to join office hours for high-touch handoffs.

Nina (Product): For credits, suggest standardizing: trials get 5k token credit or $250 account credit; enterprise pilots handled case-by-case. I'll draft a short policy we can reference in outreach.

FlareBot: deploy/retry-lease-timeout-1781240200 initiated by liam.eng — canary 2 nodes OK -> expanding to 6 nodes. Logs: https://deploys.internal/1781240200

Liam (Eng): Canary signals look good. embeddings.write_failures dropped from 42 -> 1 on canaries, search.missing_count trending down. Expanding to remaining clusters. ETA for full rollout ~45 minutes, then 2h catch-up for backlog.

Maya (CS): Good. Action plan for CS ops:
- Wait for Liam confirmation of full rollout and reduced missing_count
- If fixed within 6h: send short status update + offer office hours + credit notice
- If not fixed within 6h: escalate to exec outreach and include explicit renewal-hold language in CRM

Sofia (Support): I added the diagnostics checklist to the draft note and included a 1-question impact capture form to measure severity and collect customer feedback for the postmortem.

Carlos (Sales): Sending me the filtered list of affected accounts now. I'll prepare personalization blocks for exec-level emails.

Liam (Eng): Rollout complete across clusters. embeddings.write_failures at 0 on production canaries; search.missing_count down to baseline. Flagging for 24h watch.

FlareBot: monitoring.alert cleared for search.missing_count on prod-cluster-3 at 1781242388

Nina (Product): I'll start the postmortem doc and include a near-term mitigation (longer worker leases + import throttling) and a next-step (stronger import prechecks).

Maya (CS): I'll send the customer update now and attach office hours + credit language. After office hours we'll collect feedback and confirm whether credit needs applying per the policy. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround. :pray:
